gen-dafont-jelly-crazies-gf-noto-sans-ha: Noto Sans Hanunoo fills the line with large lowercase and open terminals, a tidy sans that stays out of the way. Jelly Crazies wobbles above it with bowls nearly sealed shut, and that closed-versus-open split is what makes the pair.
gen-dafont-jelly-crazies-gf-noto-sans-he: Playful and wobbly, Jelly Crazies keeps every stroke the same weight. Noto Sans Hebrew answers with a deep midsection and wide gaps where curves meet stems, so the two feel like opposites sharing a page.
gen-dafont-jelly-crazies-gf-noto-sans-hk: Jelly Crazies brings bowls that never thin at the sides, giving the heading a soft, bouncy bulk. And Noto Sans HK, with large lowercase and brush ends lifted before curves close, would carry a longer passage at a brisk, tidy pace.
gen-dafont-jelly-crazies-gf-noto-sans-im: Noto Sans Imperial Aramaic reads approachably, its c ends pointing apart like open pincers and capitals only a short step above the lowercase. Jelly Crazies wobbles over it, nearly closed.
gen-dafont-jelly-crazies-gf-noto-sans-in: Round, wobbly and a bit mischievous. Jelly Crazies is best at closed, marker-like heading shapes with no brush swell, while Noto Sans Inscriptional Parthian does its best work with big open eyes and a deep middle band.
gen-dafont-jelly-crazies-gf-noto-sans-jp: Jelly Crazies has joins no thinner than its stems, so every curve looks inflated and rubbery. Noto Sans JP sits below with a very tall x-height and sweeping open curves, which gives the wobble something sturdy to lean on.
gen-dafont-jelly-crazies-gf-noto-sans-ka: Jelly Crazies draws with a steady, marker-like line and bowls that nearly seal shut. But Noto Sans Kaithi, with its open e channel and lowercase filling the line like capitals, makes the split between closed and open the pair's best trait.

Noto Sans Kannada reads approachably, with a gentle bump from small letters to capitals and s curves open wide at both ends. Jelly Crazies is best at the wobbly headline; this body is best at staying open.

Wobbly bubbles over crisp, clean text. Noto Sans Kayah Li lifts its brush ends away before curves close, and that open habit against Jelly Crazies' unthinned, nearly sealed shoulders is the pair's real hook.
gen-dafont-jelly-crazies-gf-noto-sans-kh: Jelly Crazies bounces along with round bowls that never swell or thin, nearly shut at every turn. Noto Sans Kharoshthi would read as a dark, steady stripe, its curves staying open.
